API - SF-477 - Create Opportunity field Annual_GWP_Estimate_Year_1__c (editable) and sync updates back to Lead

══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

SUMMARY:
  Create Opportunity field Annual_GWP_Estimate_Year_1__c (editable) and sync updates back to Lead

DESCRIPTION:
  As a Salesforce Business User I want an Opportunity field called 
  Annual_GWP_Estimate_Year_1__c (Currency) that is editable on Opportunity, 
  and whenever that Opportunity value is updated it must also update the same 
  field on the originating Lead So that data stays consistent between 
  Opportunity and the Lead it was created from and any changes on Opportunity 
  are reflected on the Lead.

ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA:
  1. Annual_GWP_Estimate_Year_1__c field exists on Opportunity (Currency type)
  2. Field is populated from Lead.Annual_GWP_Estimate_Year_1__c on Lead conversion
  3. Field is editable on Opportunity
  4. When Opportunity.Annual_GWP_Estimate_Year_1__c is updated, it syncs back to originating Lead

API TESTING REQUIREMENTS:
  - Verify Annual_GWP_Estimate_Year_1__c field exists on Opportunity and Lead
  - Verify field maps from Lead to Opportunity during conversion
  - Verify field does NOT map to Account during conversion
  - Verify field value is preserved during Lead conversion
  - Verify updates to Opportunity sync back to Lead
  - Negative/boundary scenarios (invalid values, null handling)

Generated from: src/features/api/SF/SF-477.feature

This collection contains API tests for SF-477 work item.

**Note:** Annual_GWP_Estimate_Year_1__c is a Currency field that should:
- Auto-populate from Lead to Opportunity on conversion
- Be editable on Opportunity
- Sync back to Lead when updated on Opportunity
